text:
sylvia: FYI received an invoice from EuroGate (EG-190) for May marketplace usage. Their invoice total is in EUR and the USD equivalent on their PDF doesn't match our FX conversion. They show €14,250 -> $15,100, our conversion gave $15,720. Can partner-finance confirm exchange rate source and timestamp?

omar: I pulled our billing pipeline FX table. We apply 2026-05-31 16:00 UTC ECB midpoint rate with 1.10 EUR/USD -> $15,675 (rounded). Looks like partner used a different provider (their PDF notes a bank sell rate). Discrepancy ~ $575.

lucy: Do we treat this as a partner invoice variance to be corrected by CM, or an exchange gain/loss we absorb? Need guidance before close.

partner-finance: EuroGate confirms they used their bank's settled rate on 2026-05-31 09:00 CEST (1.06) and included a conversion fee. They propose issuing either: (A) a short-form credit memo for $575, or (B) we post an FX variance in our P&L and pay the invoice as-is. They prefer option A.

omar: Accounting note: per policy, external partner currency disputes with clear invoice error should be corrected with CM when partner accepts. If it's a FX timing difference with no partner error, we book FX P&L. This one looks like partner used a non-public sell rate + fee without disclosure -> classify as partner billing issue.

sylvia: OK propose we request CM for $575 and hold recognition on that portion until CM received. For month-close, we can post a provisional JV for the disputed amount to avoid overstating revenue. Thoughts?

lucy: Agree. Use GL 4-140 "Marketplace FX Adjustments" for the provisional contra-revenue. Amount $575. Create JV and include memo: "Pending CM from EuroGate ref EG-190 - fx conversion variance".

billing-bot: Provisional JV created: JV-2026-0621, amount $575, GL 4-140, status: PENDING_REVERSAL, ticket: FIN-4679.

partner-finance: We'll ask EuroGate to issue CM EG-CM-190 and to include the bank rate and fee detail in the RCA. We expect the CM within 4 business days.

omar: Also recommend adding an ingest check to flag invoices where partner EUR->USD rounding delta > $200 or >1.5% so we can catch these earlier. I'll open INFRA-7801.

billing-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-7801. Assigned omar.

sylvia: Draft partner message (for records):

"Subject: EG-190 - provisional adjustment posted pending credit memo"

"Hi EuroGate team,

Thanks for the invoice. We've posted a provisional adjustment (JV-2026-0621) for the USD conversion variance pending your credit memo (EG-CM-190) that documents the bank rate and fee. Please send the CM PDF to billing@redwood.ai. Once received we'll reverse the provisional JV and reconcile.

Best,
Sylvia (Finance)"

lucy: Adding note to month-close pack and marking EG-190 revenue on hold. Leave thread open until CM attached to FIN-4679.

sylvia: Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
